clos.loDetails: Remember and understand structures, commercial terms, layout, content, and style of most contract types, including sales contracts, individual contracts, transfer agreements
Apply knowledge in translating  (English-Vietnamese/Vietnamese-English) the content and structures of several types of contracts in the country and internationally.
Analyze the importance and ways to communicate in trade and contracts in a dynamic working environment in modern society.
Evaluate the form and content of each type of contract.
